plugins.name: amnesia
plugins.description: Seamless context continuity across compaction. Captures a structured handoff before each compact event and re-injects it after, so the agent resumes without losing its working state.

plugins.name: caveman-plus
plugins.description: Talk like caveman. Cut ~75% tokens. Keep all technical accuracy. Default level: full-plus.

plugins.name: total-recall
plugins.description: Cross-session, cross-CLI memory for AI coding assistants. Mines transcripts from 8 supported CLI clients and surfaces operator identity, standing decisions, bans, goals, and past corrections via 23 MCP tools, 4 hooks, and 15 slash commands. The operator becomes the source of truth; the model stops re-asking what they already told it.

plugins.name: searxng
plugins.description: Fast, token-efficient MCP for SearXNG metasearch. Privacy-respecting search across 70+ engines with stdio + streamable-http transports, Docker, and optional rendered (Playwright) fetch for JS-heavy pages. Self-hostable.

plugins.name: deepwiki
plugins.description: Talk to any public GitHub repo's auto-generated documentation via Cognition AI's hosted DeepWiki MCP. Read-only research into codebases without cloning. Thin plugin wrapping a third-party service operated by Cognition.

plugins.name: scientific-method
plugins.description: Drive debugging, performance campaigns, claim validation, and invention with the scientific method: falsifiable hypotheses, prediction-before-measurement, controlled experiments, REFUTE-first verification, and persistent falsification ledgers.
